Allflex Packaging Limited.note: Allflex Packaging Limited is a privately owned and operated flexible packaging company in New Zealand.

Carolex SAS.note: Pacur, LLC acquired Carolex SAS from epsotech Holding GmbH in 2021.

Decofilm Group.note: Decofilm Group operates as an independent manufacturer of flexible packaging and polyolefin shrink films based in Italy.

Express Plast Co. Egypt.note: Express Plast Co. is a privately held Egyptian manufacturer of flexible packaging materials established in 1986.

Gergonne Industrie.note: Gergonne Industrie is an independent manufacturer of technical adhesive tapes and medical solutions under its Adhecare brand.

Jiundar Industrial Co., Ltd..note: Jiundar Industrial Co., Ltd. is an independent manufacturer of TPU films and composite materials founded in Taiwan.

Mega Embalagens Ltda..note: Goglio S.p.A. acquired a 51% majority stake in Mega Embalagens Ltda. in 2023, which now trades as Mega Goglio.

Neelam Global Pvt. Ltd..note: Neelam Global Pvt. Ltd. is an active, privately held pharmaceutical and barrier packaging manufacturing company based in India.

Packplus Indústria e Comércio de Embalag.note: Packplus Indústria e Comércio de Embalagens Ltda. is an independent Brazilian manufacturer specialized in sterilization packaging.

Plitek, L.L.C..note: Plitek, L.L.C. operates as an independent contract converter and custom film manufacturer of precision die-cut components.

Rowland Technologies, Inc..note: ORAFOL Europe GmbH acquired Rowland Technologies, Inc. in 2017 and later absorbed it into its Advanced Polymer Films division.

Tekni-Plex, Inc..note: Genstar Capital acquired Tekni-Plex, Inc. from American Securities LLC in 2017.

Nanogruppe S.A.P.I. de C.V..note: Nanogruppe S.A.P.I. de C.V. remains an independent manufacturer specializing in digital printing and finishing services for flexible packaging in Mexico.
